description: Coverage blind spots: companies, models, and people that regional press (Chinese/East-Asian, European, Latin-American) is covering while Western/global feeds are not — ranked, with per-region item counts. Answers "what is Western tech media missing right now?". Measured within Horizon's corpus: "invisible" means zero pickup in the Western feeds Horizon tracks, not a claim about all media.
name: get_blind_spots

status.description: invisible = zero Western pickup in Horizon's corpus.

provider.description: Attribution: Horizon aggregated this result, and each item also names its own primary source. citation credits both; url is the Horizon page for this result.
